newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman starts Brit Borneo.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman starts Brit Borneo.

text.p: British Borneo Petroleum Syndicate Plc was rated "outperform" as Lehman Brothers started coverage of the oil exploration stock, the investment bank said on Wednesday.
In a research note, Lehman analysts said the company had "massive" exploration potential in the Gulf of Mexico and that new low-cost production technologies were enhancing its competitive advantages.
They said Borneo's prospects for 48 percent a year production growth made it "one of the most exciting stories in the exploration and production sector".
Lehman set a 12-month price target on the stock of 16.00 stg a share, compared with its current level of 14.35 stg.
